{{Top|leg}}
A '''holosight''' was a [[holograph]]ic projection of a crosshairs that could be generated by a [[targeting scope]] such as [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub's]] [[True Site]]. The holosight allowed the wielder to line up their [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shots more accurately. The [[polarized lens filter]]s on [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|helmets]] were known to obscure the holosight.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
